criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Purdue Housing raw page snapshot identifies FUSE at 720 Northwestern Avenue and describes its private interior quad and retail use.

Independently parsed OSM XML contains way 256639574 tagged name=FUSE and building=residential (way timestamp 2022-02-22; ODbL attribution in source XML). Against the preserved pre-edit FUSE shell, all 58 closed way vertices match (57 unique vertices) to mean nearest-vertex distance 0.0000154 m and maximum 0.0000301 m using the modular/AGENTS.md local approximate conversion.
The polygon match is compelling identity/plan evidence, though OSM is community-mapped and not survey-grade.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: The converted OSM polygon and original shell have coincident bounds: approximately X=-107.04794 to -24.57811 m and Y=561.49597 to 643.79882 m. The exact vertex correspondence validates inherited position, orientation, and plan dimensions (about 82.47 by 82.30 m) against this source.
The Mapletree coordinate is documented as an address pin, not centroid; its roughly 30 m north-south discrepancy is not a contradiction to the footprint match.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Pierce Engineers raw snapshot supports seven levels: one commercial level, four apartment levels, and two below-grade parking levels. Reopened file contains podium, four repeated upper window rows, and schematic below-grade structural decks.
The 16 m above-grade height is inherited, not independently measured. The source snapshot does not validate that height or roof profile; the flat roof and deck layout remain schematic.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: The saved model contains repeated glazing/frame bays, brick piers, light spandrels, storefront glazing, a double-leaf door feature, and a FUSE sign; the exterior preview visibly shows the overall repeated façade, while the sign and doors are not legible from that view.

Facade color is attributed in evidence.json to a LoopNet image reference, but there is no raw snapshot. Exact bay rhythm, panel dimensions, sign and entrance locations are explicitly estimated and lack plans/elevations.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Reopened the saved asset in Blender 4.5.15: Asset_massing_fuse_39cf4b5 exists with 10 objects; FUSE shell has no unapplied modifiers; all four image textures are packed and no external FILE image paths remain.

Dedicated build script, two previews, raw Purdue/Pierce/OSM snapshots, and a structured evidence record are present. However, per-source CRS/retrieval/source-date/measurement/uncertainty fields are inconsistent or absent; the LoopNet snapshot is null; Mapletree is represented only by a snippet plus failed-fetch record. Shared manifest object_count/objects still describe the one-object legacy export and should be reconciled by the coordinator.

evidence.detail: Opened directly in Blender 4.5.15. Inspected collection membership, evaluated mesh bounds, modifiers, font/sign object, and packed/external image state.
Reviewed source claims, source metadata, edits, measurements, uncertainties, and preview paths.
Reopened the preserved original shell and independently extracted unique ground-plane vertices.
Parsed raw XML, selected way 256639574 by its name=FUSE and building=residential tags, and independently compared all closed-ring vertices after applying the documented local approximate conversion.
Raw Purdue Housing source snapshot reviewed for building identity, address, retail, and courtyard facts.
Raw Pierce Engineers source snapshot reviewed for seven-level use program.
Viewed saved exterior preview; repeated façade and courtyard are visible; doors/sign are not legible from this angle.
Viewed saved plan preview; square perimeter and centered approximate court are visible.
Reviewed the dedicated build logic for edits and which features are explicitly modeled as estimates.

findings: FAIL: 7.5/10 remains below the repository 8/10 passing standard.
Strongly supported plan geometry and horizontal placement are established by exact correspondence to the named OSM FUSE polygon; retain the caveat that OSM is not a survey.
Obtain an authoritative height/elevation or clearly keep the 16 m height marked unverified; the seven-level program is supported but roof form and basement configuration are schematic.

Save an inspectable dated façade/entrance image or elevation source if available; document which entrance(s) are real and their locations. Current door placements are symmetric estimates and the preview does not clearly show them.

Complete source metadata consistently, including CRS, retrieval date, source date when available, measurement method, uncertainty, and raw snapshot for the LoopNet visual reference; the Mapletree page attempt remains a non-content HTTP 405 log plus snippet.
Coordinator should update the shared manifest object list/count to match the ten-object export collection before integration.
